details:
I have an idea for a comprehensive RPG plugin/feature specifically designed for VRChat, with features focusing on tracking various user activities and interactions within the virtual environment. Here's a summarized list:

   Main Features:

- Simulated to real-life experience, specifically for VRChat

- Acts as a clean UI overlay with options for comfort or immersion

- Functions as a stat tracker for various user activities and interactions

   Tracked Activities and Interactions:

- Type of worlds joined and whether conversations with other users occur

- Socializing behaviors (e.g., talking/not talking/responding when spoken to)

- Emotional states (e.g., happiness, sadness, anger)

- Activity levels with potential systems to increase activeness

- Avatar creation and potential integration with chatGPT for asset and clothing suggestions

- Linking to worlds for potential rewards and points for stats

   Skill Tree and Leveling System:

- Incorporates a skill tree based on real-life activities to level up skills

- Potential traits for each skill (e.g., social, activeness, party, loner, emotions)

- Leveling up grants points and rewards, possibly tied to visiting linked worlds

- Introduces a marketplace for creators to sell items, assets, plugins, and shaders, with the ability to use points to support creators

- Includes inventory items for interaction between users and avatars

- Supports items that can be directly integrated into Unity for user creativity

The idea revolves around creating a more enhanced connection between VRChat to a true metaverse, which connects you to all of the worlds more immersively.

This concept could add a new layer of engagement and depth to the VRChat community. I believe it would also be perfect for implementing bigger events like, a world based on a huge stage for Vocaloid singers, Vtuber singers, with a hologram of them dancing, as well as a main entrance with booths that allow selling or advertising of creative tools for unity for VRChat.

I know this idea is probably big in the forums or what not, but I'd like to post this in hopes it gets added. Thanks for hearing me out. 

P.S: I'm just a normal guy who likes to play games with a creative head. Feel free to ask for more in-depth answers, though you can get the idea. I don't mind others throwing in their own ideas, I'd just be happy if this gets thought/talked about.

I don't have the ability to create this myself, so that's why i am posting it here.
title: IRL Simulated RPG Like Interface
